owningLaneForSourceAcquisition.laneNote: Lane D owns the acquisition IF a form exists. It cannot act until lane F establishes whether one does — the track's implementationQueue is F_source_problem.
owningLaneForSourceAcquisition.scope: Lane F source resolution first: search the Illinois Prisoner Review Board's published materials, its Guidelines series, and any Board rule under 730 ILCS 5/3-3-2(a)(10) or 730 ILCS 5/5-5.5 for an application by which a non-military petitioner requests a certificate of eligibility for expungement under 20 ILCS 2630/5.2(e-6). If such a form exists, lane D acquires it, hashes it, maps its fields and builds the overlay. If no such form exists, the branch is a legal-design question for lane E — what does the Board actually accept from a non-military petitioner seeking an expungement certificate, and is there a vehicle at all — and lane C still drafts nothing, because the Board publishes its own forms for both sibling branches and a bespoke application would invent a vehicle.

components.draftingProhibitedBecause: It is an official OCA statewide model form with a recorded officialFormId and officialSourceUrl, and the registry classifies the unit official_pdf_fill with packetIdentity 'identified'. Lane C drafts no official forms. The OCA nondisclosure documents are statewide MODEL forms — not mandatory and not promulgated. Gov't Code 411.0745(c) and (d) direct OCA to prescribe and publish a form for petitions filed electronically or by mail and require every county and district clerk website to link to it, so they sit closer to a statutorily authorised statewide model than to a sample, and county clerks across Texas republish them and refer filers to the OCA site. Nothing in Subchapter E-1 makes the form mandatory or forbids a differently drafted petition, and this artifact does not assert that it is mandatory. The registry nevertheless classifies this unit official_pdf_fill with packetIdentity 'identified', so the route uses the OCA form rather than a drafted substitute, and lane C drafts no official forms.
